The attacker advances while the defender is on the ground, indicating continuation of the physical confrontation; the defender appears to be recovering or evading.

The attacker, still reeling from the blow, is struck again or continues to be engaged; the defender follows through with the weapon amid lingering smoke/dust.

Both participants actively resist and counterattack throughout.
